description_en: Queries a list of deployment packages. This feature corresponds to the deployment package list on the task deployment page in the DataWorks console
description_zh: 查询发布包列表信息。该功能与DataWorks控制台任务发布页面的发布包列表功能对应
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-deployments --project-identifier dw_project --project-id 10000 --creator '20030****' --end-create-time 1593877765000 --executor '2003****' --end-execute-time 1593877765000 --status 1 --keyword hello --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDeployments

parameters.help_en:
The name of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the workspace configuration page to obtain the workspace name.

You must specify either this parameter or ProjectId to determine the DataWorks workspace for this API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的名称。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间名称。

该参数与ProjectId参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the workspace configuration page to obtain the workspace ID.

You must specify either this parameter or ProjectIdentifier to determine the DataWorks workspace for this API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。

该参数与ProjectIdentifier参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud user ID of the creator of the deployment package
parameters.help_zh: 发布包创建者的阿里云用户ID
parameters.name: creator

parameters.help_en: The maximum timestamp in milliseconds for the creation time of the deployment package
parameters.help_zh: 生成发布包的最大毫秒时间戳
parameters.name: end_create_time

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud user ID of the executor of the deployment package
parameters.help_zh: 发布包执行者的阿里云用户ID
parameters.name: executor

parameters.help_en: The maximum timestamp in milliseconds for the execution start time of the deployment package
parameters.help_zh: 发布包开始执行的最大毫秒时间戳
parameters.name: end_execute_time

parameters.help_en:
The current status of the deployment package. Valid values:
0: The deployment package is ready.
1: The deployment package is deployed.
2: The deployment package failed to be deployed.
6: The deployment package is rejected
parameters.help_zh:
发布包当前的状态。取值如下：
0：发布包已准备就绪。
1：发布包发布成功。
2：发布包发布失败。
6：发布包被驳回
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The keyword in the name of the deployment package. DataWorks supports fuzzy matching. You can enter a keyword to query deployment packages whose names contain the keyword
parameters.help_zh: 发布包名称的关键字。DataWorks支持模糊匹配，即输入关键字，即可查询包含该关键字的发布包
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.help_zh: 请求的数据页数，用于翻页
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大为100条
parameters.name: page_size

Data.description_en: The list of deployment packages that meet the query conditions
Data.description_zh: 满足查询条件的发布包列表数据

Deployments.description_en: The returned list of deployment packages

items.description_en: The details of the deployment package

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the deployment package was created

Creator.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud user ID of the creator of the deployment package
Creator.description_zh: 发布包创建者的阿里云用户ID

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message recorded when the deployment package fails to be executed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 当发布包执行失败，该参数用于记录错误信息

ExecuteTime.description_en: The timestamp when the deployment package was executed

Executor.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud user ID of the executor of the deployment package
Executor.description_zh: 发布包执行者的阿里云用户ID

Id.description_en: The ID of the deployment package. You can use this ID to call the [GetDeployment]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173950.html） operation to obtain the details of the deployment package
Id.description_zh: 发布包的ID，您可以根据此ID调用[GetDeployment]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173950.html）接口，获取发布包详情

Name.description_en: The name of the deployment package

Status.description_en:
The current status of the deployment package. Valid values:
0: The deployment package is ready.
1: The deployment package is deployed.
2: The deployment package failed to be deployed.
6: The deployment package is rejected
Status.description_zh:
发布包当前的状态。取值如下：
0：发布包已准备就绪。
1：发布包发布成功。
2：发布包发布失败。
6：发布包被驳回

PageNumber.description_en: The number of the page to return
PageNumber.description_zh: 请求的数据页数，用于翻页

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries that meet the conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足条件的数据总条数

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于出现错误后排查问题
